nodes.label: AGENTS.md — Next.js 16 agent rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The block is written and re-added by next dev (see node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js), so removing it from a diff only recreates the uncommitted change.
